purpose: Authoring and testing metadata, not permissions or an automatic executor.

operate.trigger: Inspect, build, debug, and capture TouchDesigner projects through td-mcp-rs. Entry point for live operator work, scripting, and offline project tools.
operate.nonTrigger: Does not require a live process for offline explanations or files.
operate.evidenceScope: Source/unit/native claims are scoped individually; no blanket native verification.

opsketch-notation.trigger: Sketch topology when planning branches/interfaces or explaining a network. Optional notation reference, not a node-count gate for ordinary edits.
opsketch-notation.nonTrigger: Node count alone is not a sketch trigger.
opsketch-notation.evidenceScope: Source/unit/native claims are scoped individually; no blanket native verification.

opsketch-importance-gating.trigger: Decide which parameters to surface in an OpSketch. Use when sketching a network or judging whether a parameter belongs in a node's {} block.
opsketch-importance-gating.nonTrigger: Do not load or execute examples unless they resolve a task-relevant question.
opsketch-importance-gating.evidenceScope: Source/unit/native claims are scoped individually; no blanket native verification.

opsketch-examples.trigger: Worked OpSketch transcriptions. Use when unsure how to sketch a live inspect result, a wire summary, a custom COMP, or an api_help card.
opsketch-examples.nonTrigger: Do not load or execute examples unless they resolve a task-relevant question.
opsketch-examples.evidenceScope: Source/unit/native claims are scoped individually; no blanket native verification.

python-api.trigger: Choose and run custom Python with explicit imports, scope and effect checks. Read before first MCP Python use; follow technical references only for unresolved APIs. Not a sandbox or an obligatory full manual for scalar edits.
python-api.nonTrigger: Not required for a structured scalar read/write with no custom Python.
python-api.evidenceScope: Source/unit/native claims are scoped individually; no blanket native verification.

delta-guarded-writes.trigger: Take a stamped baseline, diff a fresh read against it, and write only if the field still holds what you read. Use when a change must be confirmed or a write must not clobber an edit you did not make.
delta-guarded-writes.nonTrigger: Does not replace inspect for reading detail, and does not make a write atomic or exactly-once; it narrows a race and reports what it observed.
delta-guarded-writes.evidenceScope: Comparison and guard semantics are unit-tested against fake operators; no native acceptance run has yet shown a real diff on a real project.

custom-parameters.trigger: Create, read, and update COMP custom parameters. Use when adding pages/pars, menus, toggles, pulses, About fields, or enableExpr bindings.
custom-parameters.nonTrigger: Do not load or execute examples unless they resolve a task-relevant question.
custom-parameters.evidenceScope: Source/unit/native claims are scoped individually; no blanket native verification.

mutation-zones.trigger: Choose where to build and mutate. Use before creating or changing nodes: self-created named COMP, user-authorized subtree, or editor hint confirmed with inspect.
mutation-zones.nonTrigger: Do not load or execute examples unless they resolve a task-relevant question.
mutation-zones.evidenceScope: Source/unit/native claims are scoped individually; no blanket native verification.

network-design.evidenceScope: Source/unit/native claims are scoped individually; no blanket native verification.
